observations: White PlayStation 5 Slim console with a black horizontal stripe across the center.
Two DualSense wireless controllers, one white and one black, are shown next to the console.
The console is being held by a person's hand.
The background is a dark, marbled or stone-patterned surface.
A watermark 'POSTED SHOW GAMES' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The console is a UK model, but the photo is a generic stock image and cannot confirm the specific unit's history.
The photo shows two controllers, but it is impossible to distinguish between a single DualSense and two separate controllers.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a hardware fault.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the PlayStation Store menu.

risks.risk: The controllers may have stick drift, button failure, or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controllers being used to navigate menus or play a game.

risks.risk: The internal storage capacity (500GB vs 1TB) is unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen in the console settings.

risks.risk: The console may have a 'Blue Light of Death' (BLOD) or other critical hardware failure.
risks.proof: A video of the console running a diagnostic tool or a long-term usage test.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the controllers being used to navigate menus or play a game.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the storage capacity.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the software version.
Photo of the original receipt mentioned in the description.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
